title: voice-kit resource manifest
description: What contract/resources.yaml may say. One entry per Telenow-backed resource the kit keeps in its own database (plan §3.8): its table, the Telenow operations that write and read it, how its columns map to Telenow's fields, the events that update it, how it is back-filled, and what is never stored. Each backend runs one generic engine over these entries; contract/tests checks every Telenow operation, field and event named here against Telenow's released API document.

resources.description: Keyed by the resource's kit name.

objectAt.description: Where the resource's object sits in the operation's answer, dot-separated (`data` for Telenow's {success, data} answers); empty or absent when the answer is the object itself.

mergeBlobs.description: JSON fields Telenow REPLACES whole when sent. The engine re-reads the object, changes only the keys the customer edited, and sends the result; a blob the customer did not touch is never sent (plan §3.8 a.5).

body.description: Fields every such write carries as they are (Telenow's create needs `sessionConfig`, say), beside the mapped fields.

telenow.description: The field in the read operation's answer, dot-separated for nested objects.

write.description: The field's name in Telenow's write requests (create and update), when the kit writes it.

on.description: Which writes carry it; absent: both. (Telenow's agent create takes no isActive.)

writer.description: kit: the customer creates and edits it in the kit, which sends the writes through the outbox. telenow: Telenow produces it; only events and back-fill write it.

kitIdSlot.description: Where the kit's own id travels inside the Telenow object, dot-separated (e.g. metadata.kitId), or null when Telenow has no slot and the kit keeps the mapping (plan §3.8 a.6).

events.description: Telenow webhook events that update this resource; each must be an event Telenow's document lists.

mode.description: changed-since: a feed with a cursor; window: re-read recent days; full: the whole list, compared; per-row: re-read each unfinished row; drift-check: re-read each row and compare with the stored snapshot.

cursorParameter.description: For changed-since: the query parameter that resumes the feed.

startParameter.description: For changed-since: the query parameter that starts the feed at an instant, before there is a cursor.

permission.description: The kit permission a member needs to change it.

neverStored.description: Telenow fields the kit never stores or shows (Telenow's prices, provider secrets), dot-separated. A shared test scans kit API answers for them.

extraReads.description: Further Telenow reads that fill one column each, beside `telenow.read` (a call's analysis comes from its own operation).

objectAt.description: Where the resource's object sits in the operation's answer, dot-separated (`data` for Telenow's {success, data} answers); empty or absent when the answer is the object itself.

whenPresent.description: Read only while the read answer's `completeness` says this part is `present`.
